entries.4ee75ffce3e1575d: In the field of EMC (electromagnetic compatibility) for electronic equipment, it supports EMC conformity testing and also provides OTA measurement systems for 5G and connected cars, among others. The company, together with Dongyang Jingce Xitong (Shanghai) Co., Ltd., Dongyang Jingce Guoji Co., Ltd., TOYOTech LLC, AeroGT Labs Corporation and Toyo EMC Engineering Co., Ltd., is responsible for this business. entries.5788baff3b9e5647: Since entering the electronic measurement instrument field in 1955 through a sole distributorship agreement with the UK's EMI, it has combined the handling of advanced overseas measurement instruments with the development of its own original products. A distinctive feature is its group structure, which handles support, maintenance, repair and calibration accompanying the provision of products.
